player_prompt.intro:
Kamogelo mo Letsha la Gaenetsi!

O emetswe ke 'P' mo grid.
Mabodi a grid:
  ' ' = Sehafa se se tletseng (se bolokele go tsamaya)
  'H' = Logaga (wa neelela o bo o lahlegetse!)
  'G' = Bokhutlo (fikela fa go wina!)
  'P' = Maemo a gago a jaanong

Ditiro tse di kgatlhileng: godimo, tlase, go le letona, go le letshoho (kgotsa w, a, s, d)
Tlhagisa ditiro tsa gago jaana: [up], [down], [left], [right] kgotsa [w], [a], [s], [d]

Bokhutlo: Kgweetsa go tswa kwa tshimologo (godimo-letona) go ya kwa bokhutlo (tlase-letshoho) ntle le go neelela mo logageng lepe!

invalid_move.wrong_format: Tswelelo e seng wa kwa molao. Tswelela [up], [down], [left], [right] gape [w], [a], [s], [d].
invalid_move.unknown_action: Tiragatso e sa itsiweng '{action}'. Dirisa godimo, tlase, molemeng, mojeng kgotsa w, a, s, d.
invalid_move.hit_wall: O ne wa leka go tsamaya {action} mme o ne wa thula lebota!

game_action.moved: O ile wa tswelela {action} go ya kwa poso ({row}, {col}).

outcome.fell_in_hole: O wetse mo mosimeng! Motshameko o fedile. O weditse {pct}% ya loeto go fitlha kwa mokgeleng.
outcome.turn_limit: O fitlheletse tekanyetso ya go retologa! Motshameko o fedile. O weditse {pct}% ya loeto lwa gago go fitlha kwa mokgeleng.
